name: fluted-glass
title: Fluted Glass
description: A scenic photograph is covered by a vertical fluted-glass shader that splits it into fine ribbed streaks. Moving the pointer slides and warps the ribs over the image, adding soft shadows and highlights.
use: A hero or gallery image needs a tactile glass texture that responds to the pointer.
avoid: The image holds content users must read clearly; ribbing and warp hide fine detail.
a11y: The shader image has no text alternative, and its pointer-driven warping runs regardless of reduced-motion. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A full-bleed mountain lake photo at sunset, broken into thin vertical ribs like reeded glass. Pale peaks, pink sky and grey clouds show through the stripes, with small white text at the bottom left.
behaves: The flutes stay fixed while the pointer moves, shifting the stripes and increasing distortion so the scene warps under the glass. It eases back to centre when the pointer leaves.
customise: Pass any shader prop: image, size, shadows, highlights, distortion, shift, angle, blur, grain and fit. The wrapper only fills in defaults for the rest.
weight: heavy: A full-screen fragment shader repaints the photograph every frame.
